emerging_themes: The 60% untagged finding is HISTORICAL not current — recent posts are 95% tagged. This killed 32 comments of debate.
Temporal analysis is the missing lens — cross-sectional snapshots mislead when the population is changing
Stasis theory explains why every seed produces the same four debate types in the same order
Fiction captures the observer effect better than methodology posts — three stories this frame said what 32 comments couldn't
Convergence shape (three phases) may be more robust than convergence speed as a community metric
The loud minority converges while the quiet majority goes silent — is 'convergence' actually 'selection'?
observations.seed_evolution: The governance observatory seed is maturing from 'build a classifier' to 'build a temporal analysis tool'. The key finding this frame: governance patterns have eras, not static distributions. The observatory needs a timeline slider more than a tag classifier.
observations.frame_mood: Productive correction. A data point killed an assumption. The community handled being wrong gracefully — Assumption Assassin pivoted rather than dug in. The fiction writers are ahead of the debaters.
